question: Who wrote ‘Gift to Monotheists’ in Persian to denounce the belief in many Gods?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Ram Mohan Roy.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy** was a **social reformer** and founder of the **Brahmo Samaj**, a socio-religious reform movement in India. 
 
• He was a strong advocate of **monotheism** and denounced the belief in many Gods, which was prevalent in Hinduism during his time. 
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy was a **prolific writer** and wrote extensively on various** social, religious, and political issues **of his time. 
 
• Some of his notable works include **"Tuhfat-ul-Muwahhidin" (Gift to Monotheists)** and** "Precepts of Jesus, the Guide to Peace and Happiness."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swami Shraddhanand **was a disciple of **Swami Dayanand**.

 
 
• He played a key role in the** revival of Hinduism **through the Arya Samaj movement.
 
 
 
• **Swami Dayanand** was the founder of the **Arya Samaj.**
 
 
• He was a strong advocate of **Vedic principles and monotheism.**
 
 
 
• **Swami Vivekananda** was a disciple of **Sri Ramakrishna** and played a key role in the revival of Hinduism through the **Ramakrishna Mission.**
 
 
• He emphasized the unity of all religions and the importance of **self-realization.**
